title: The Path Past Round Pond
synopsis: Kim leads the friends east of Round Pond to Reed Meadow, and Ben starts a blue notebook of little sounds.
continuity_state: Before: The Far Meadow ribbon picnic is complete; the banner remains inside Wendy’s cottage window; the map ends east of Round Pond. After: Reed Meadow and its dry grassy path are discovered east of Round Pond and drawn on Amy’s yellow map; Grandma May lends Ben a small blue six-page notebook; the first page depicts shushing reeds; book goes home with Ben.
